purpose: The short heading that names a group of Sidebar rows; it hides while the Sidebar is collapsed. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a SidebarGroup.

Default.visual: Caption text in Content/secondary, in its original case.

notes: It is the label of the group (aria-labelledby).

openQuestions: The Figma description says uppercase but the text case is original. Which is right?
